blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Peppermint Bizmoto Inc. (“Peppermint”), a licensed electronic money issuer (EMI) in the Philippines, has entered into a strategic partnership with HaveIt, a growing digital services platform, to provide the payment infrastructure supporting its expanding ecosystem. Under the partnership, Peppermint will serve as the payment rails provider for HaveIt, enabling digital payment processing across its platform and supporting the company’s continued expansion in transportation and other consumer services. A key part of HaveIt’s ecosystem is Ride It, a transportation network company (TNC) operating in the Philippines with a network of over 6,000 riders.
